title: “He’s not training cheerleaders. He’s forging conquerors.”
paragraphs: “He’s not training cheerleaders. He’s forging conquerors.”

When you walk with the Lion of Judah, you stop acting tame
He’s not looking for applause. He’s raising those who roar.

Proverbs 28:1
“The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.”
— boldness born from righteousness, not performance.
